agent_draft.bar.drafts: {n} agent changes wait for your Apply
agent_draft.set.drafts: Agent changes wait in a draft until you apply them
agent_draft.card.asked: The agent asks you to review and apply its draft. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
agent_draft.card.title: External agent changes
agent_draft.card.stale: The model changed after this draft was made. Re-check it before Apply.
agent_draft.card.blocked: A check blocks this draft. Fix or untick the operation first.
agent_draft.card.none: Tick at least one operation that changes the model.
agent_draft.card.busy: Wait until the current work ends.

agent_draft.card.discard.desc: Drops the whole draft. The model is not changed.
agent_draft.applied: Agent draft applied as one undo step
agent_draft.discarded: Agent draft discarded; the model is unchanged
agent_draft.unsaved.agent: External agent changes not applied: {n}. Closing drops them.
